# BERIAS Sprint
> Free back-office health check for freight brokers, 3PLs, and carriers.

## Main pages
- https://sprint.berias.com/
- https://sprint.berias.com/assessment/
- https://sprint.berias.com/privacy.html
- https://sprint.berias.com/impressum.html

## Tool summary
The Back-Office Health Check is a free 15-question web assessment that helps freight brokers, 3PLs, and carriers identify operational friction points and evaluate their process maturity. It provides an instant score, category breakdown, practical recommendations, and a downloadable PDF summary in about 5 minutes.
